description: October 2026 retraining campaign: every organism retrained with the Trainer-default global token-mean objective (docs/P001_REPRODUCTION.md). Run with gpu_queue.py and train_and_eval_campaign.sh (working-directory copy of scripts/gpu/train_and_eval.sh at the time). Host B: the single-GPU trainings, every method run, and the historical-adapter validation.
